name: end_call
description: End the current call. Use this when the conversation is naturally complete and the customer's request has been fulfilled, or when the customer explicitly asks to end the call.

reason.description: Brief reason for ending the call, e.g. 'booking_confirmed', 'inquiry_resolved', 'customer_requested_end'

name: transfer_to_agent
description: Transfer the caller to a human agent. Use this when the customer explicitly requests a human agent, or when you cannot resolve the issue.

reason.description: Brief reason for the transfer, e.g. 'customer_requested', 'unable_to_resolve', 'complex_issue'

summary.description: Summary of the conversation so far, including what the customer asked for and any actions taken. This helps the human agent pick up the conversation.
